name.title: Platform log name
name.description: Label for this platform in Homebridge logs. Accessory names come from the controller.

name.title: Controller log label (optional)
name.description: Defaults to Controller 1, Controller 2, etc. This label does not rename Home accessories.

ipAddress.title: IP address
ipAddress.description: The wall-mounted controller's IP address. A reserved address in your router is recommended.

port.title: Controller API port
port.description: Leave at 2025 unless your controller uses a different API port. This is not the Homebridge bridge port.

debug.title: Detailed debug logging
debug.description: Include sanitised request timing, read summaries and command confirmations. Also enable Homebridge debug logging.
